sections.title: What can be established here
sections.text: This is Conway and Norton’s 1979 paper in Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society, volume 11, pages 308–339.

sections.title: Claim described by the later proof
sections.text: Borcherds explains their central conjecture as the existence of a graded Monster module whose element-trace series are specified genus-zero Hauptmoduls. His theorem establishes this for the Frenkel–Lepowsky–Meurman module.

sections.title: What has not been read
sections.text: The original text, numerical tables and detailed argument were unavailable in this pass. A paper-specific method or results summary would exceed the evidence; this guide intentionally does not invent one.

sections.title: A useful reading route
sections.text: Read the later proof introduction for a precise statement, then consult the original to see the conjectural evidence in its historical form.
